tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a new kitchen appliance from a store called 'Home Essentials.' After using it for a few days, you noticed some problems with it. You want to inform the customer service representative, Ms. Parker, about the issue. Write an email to Ms. Parker.
bullets: Describe the issue you are experiencing with the kitchen appliance.
Explain why this issue is problematic for you.
Request a replacement or repair for the appliance.
tasks.subject: Issue with kitchen appliance purchase
